# Pixel Virtual Pet

A simple offline browser app featuring a CSS-drawn pixel creature with hunger, happiness, and energy bars. Use the Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons to interact and keep your pet happy.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Features

- Three stat bars (hunger, happiness, energy) with live updates.
- Mood text that reflects overall well-being.
- Feed, Play, and Sleep actions with trade-offs.
- Passive stat decay over time.
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states.
- Responsive design down to 360px width.

## Files

- `index.html` — main structure
- `styles.css` — theming and layout
- `app.js` — game logic
- `README.md` — this file

## Accessibility

- Stat bars use `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`.
- Mood changes announced via `aria-live="polite"`.
- Buttons are focusable and have clear focus rings.

## Notes

All assets are generated with CSS; no external dependencies or network requests.
